caseno: Death Reference No. 07 of 1995 with Jail Appeal No. 1915 of 1995.
lawyer:
Md Mostafa, Assistant Attorney-General—For the State. 
Mrs Sabera Begum, Advocate—For Condemned Prisoner.
parties:
Bilkis Ara Begum ------ Appellants
Vs.
State ------ Respondent
full_judgment: 25. Mr Mohammad Mostafa, the learned Assistant Attorney-General for the State in support of the reference placed the evidence from the record and submitted that the reference is required to be accepted as the prosecution proved the charge against the condemned prisoner through the evidence of witnesses and also through certain other circumstances. He further submitted that the evidence of PW 4 Most. Shakhina Begum, PW 55 Zaheda Khatun and PW 8 Shahidul Islam alias Saidul coupled with the seized alamats including two eyeballs of the deceased unerringly lead to the presumption of guilt of the condemned prisoner and that besides the evidence of the witnesses, confessional statement of the condemned prisoner recorded by the PW 10 under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure abundantly makes it clear that it is nobody else but the condemned prisoner who committed the murder of her child the victim Farzana Boby and, as such, the judgment and order passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge convicting the condemned prisoner for the offence is sustainable in law. Referring to the sentence imposed against the condemned prisoner he submits that considering the mental condition of the condemned prisoner and also the period of her confinement in the condemned cell the sentence may be commuted.
